project.name: nvidia_chat
project.description: ApexQuantumICT: Quantum-geometric market analysis with canonical rootfile architecture

analysisScope.focus: Rootfile irreducible canonical hamiltonians and orchestration

canonicalHamiltonians.name: State Space
canonicalHamiltonians.description: Raw market data becomes typed runtime state. External inputs (MT5, Deriv, TradingView) are normalized into canonical market state representation (OHLCV, microstructure, symbol, source, stage context).

implementations.description: Canonical data structure that flows through entire pipeline, maintaining typed state at each stage
State preparation adapter for normalized market data ingestion
First pipeline stage, loads and validates raw market data

exports: market_state dict with (price, time, liquidity coordinates)

canonicalHamiltonians.name: Geometry - Liquidity Field & Metric
canonicalHamiltonians.description: Liquidity structure from ICT patterns becomes metric tensor on Riemannian manifold. The scalar field ϕ(p,t) encodes resistance as curvature: high ϕ = high resistance, low ϕ = easy flow.

implementations.description: Scalar field ϕ(p,t) = Σ[weights × ict_features]. Combines order block density, liquidity pools, FVGs, spread, session penalties. Foundation for metric and connection.
Conformal metric ds² = e^(2ϕ)(dp² + dt²). Maps liquidity field into Riemannian geometry.
Extracts ICT geometry (order blocks, FVGs, liquidity pools) from market state
Computes liquidity field, metric tensor, connection, and curvature

canonicalHamiltonians.name: Connection - Christoffel Symbols
canonicalHamiltonians.description: Liquidity gradients bend trajectory evolution. Connection coefficients Γⁱⱼₖ encode how paths curve through the liquidity field, transforming straight lines into geodesics that follow market structure.

implementations.description: Γⁱⱼₖ = ∂ϕ/∂xⁱ terms. Bends candidate trajectories through liquidity gradients. 2D case with price and time coordinates.
Applies geodesic deviation equation d²xⁱ/dλ² + Γⁱⱼₖ(dxʲ/dλ)(dxᵏ/dλ) = 0 to trajectory seeds

canonicalHamiltonians.name: Curvature - Regime Classification
canonicalHamiltonians.description: Gaussian curvature K classifies market regime: K>0 (basin/attractor), K≈0 (flat/trend), K<0 (saddle/breakout). Determines path selection bias and entry zone affinity.

implementations.description: K = -e^(-2ϕ) · Δϕ. Computes Laplacian of liquidity field. Returns regime classification (BASIN/FLAT/SADDLE/TRANSITION).
Maps K values to market regimes and adjusts path integral weights accordingly

canonicalHamiltonians.name: Path Space - Trajectory Generation
canonicalHamiltonians.description: Candidate market futures are generated as N trajectories through state space via RK4 integration. Each seed is corrected by geodesic deviation, then evolved with 4th-order Runge-Kutta under Hamiltonian dynamics. Action S[γ] is computed for each path.

implementations.description: Data class representing single candidate path: (time, price) points, energy, action, operator scores, predicted PnL
Bisection calibration of effective Planck constant ℏ to target ESS (Effective Sample Size) ≈ 0.5
Computes action S[γ] = ∫L dt and weights trajectories via exp(-S[γ]/ℏ) Wick rotation
Creates N candidate trajectories with geodesic-corrected seeds

exports: Trajectory objects with action and energy
canonicalHamiltonians.mathematicalBasis: Feynman path integral with Wick rotation: P[γ] ∝ exp(-S[γ]/ℏ)

canonicalHamiltonians.name: Ramanujan Compression - Path Family Signatures
canonicalHamiltonians.description: Candidate paths compress into deterministic behavior families using v1 Ramanujan signatures (liquidity, time, entry, risk, topology). Reduces exploration space from N trajectories to K families with shared characteristics.

implementations.description: Groups trajectories into deterministic families using path signature hashing
Deterministic v1 signature based on: liquidity profile, time-to-target, entry zone, risk geometry, topological class

canonicalHamiltonians.futureWork: Deepen signatures with richer ICT lineage and empirical family scoring

canonicalHamiltonians.name: Action - Cost & Scoring
canonicalHamiltonians.description: Paths receive weighted cost across four dimensions: liquidity resistance S_L, time-to-target S_T, entry-zone quality S_E, and risk geometry S_R. Composite action score determines proposal ranking.

implementations.description: Computes S[γ] = w_L·S_L + w_T·S_T + w_E·S_E + w_R·S_R for each trajectory
Evaluates actions and assigns operator scores to all trajectories
Applies path integral weighting and interference selection

canonicalHamiltonians.name: Admissibility - Constraint Projectors
canonicalHamiltonians.description: Forbidden proposals are refused before collapse. Risk manager, constraint Hamiltonian, and admissibility gates reject paths violating risk limits, session constraints, regime conditions, or kernel laws. Refusal produces evidence without reaching scheduler.

implementations.description: Enforces daily loss limits, position sizing, max positions per symbol, correlated exposure, kill switch
Projects proposed actions onto admissible subspace defined by risk levels (GREEN/YELLOW/RED/KILL)
Result of risk check: passed bool, level (RiskLevel enum), message, metric, value, limit
Early filtering stage before entropy gate
Final admissibility check before entropy gate and scheduler

canonicalHamiltonians.name: Entropy Gate - Information Gain
canonicalHamiltonians.description: Information gain is measured before scheduler authority collapses the wave function. Gate measures prior path uncertainty, posterior action-weight uncertainty, and mutual information. Threshold must be exceeded to reach scheduler.

implementations.description: Measures ΔS = H_posterior - H_prior + I(trajectory, weights). Blocks collapse if ΔS < threshold.
Computes prior uncertainty (uniform distribution over trajectories), posterior uncertainty (after action weighting), and mutual information

canonicalHamiltonians.futureWork: Calibrate threshold empirically against production data

canonicalHamiltonians.name: Scheduler Authority - Token Issuance
canonicalHamiltonians.description: The scheduler is the sole authority that may issue execution tokens. No other component self-authorizes collapse. Token minting is gated by prior constraints, admissibility, entropy, and regime checks. Represents the authoritative collapse decision point.

implementations.description: Master scheduler that mints execution tokens. Sole authority for collapse decision. Maintains token manager and can revoke tokens.
Canonical token facade over TAEP and trading scheduler tokens. Contains operation, budget, expiry_duration, constraints metadata.
Manages token lifecycle: issuance, validation, revocation. Tracks budget and scope.
Invokes scheduler to authorize selected trajectory and mint execution token
Explicit H10 law adapter over Scheduler.authorize_collapse()

canonicalHamiltonians.name: Collapse/Execution - Authorized State Changes
canonicalHamiltonians.description: Authorized proposals become controlled side effects. Execution boundary (shadow, live, HFT, broker) validates token before issuing broker calls. Failed token validation emits refusal evidence without executing trade.

implementations.description: Token-gated shadow execution boundary. Validates token before calling ShadowTradingLoop.
Paper trading execution on demo accounts (no real capital)
Master orchestrator that wires canonical loop, state machine validates transitions, emits evidence
Rootfile adapter for canonical Apex engine orchestration
Explicit 7-state machine: IDLE → CONSTRAINED → COLLAPSED → EXECUTING → RECONCILED → EVIDENCED → IDLE. Each transition validated.
Executes authorized token-gated broker call

exports: ExecutionResult with outcome, token, trajectory, evidence_hash

canonicalHamiltonians.name: Reconciliation - Outcome Validation
canonicalHamiltonians.description: Broker reality reconciles intended and realized state. Compares proposal expectations with actual fills, prices, timestamps. Realized closed-trade PnL feeds settlement and learning. Falsification scoring for research purposes.

implementations.description: Canonical reconciliation summary: broker, accepted bool, status, realized_pnl, evidence_valid, admissible, information_gain, scheduler_authorized
Converts MT5/Deriv settlement report objects into canonical ReconciliationReport
MT5 and Deriv settlement bridges. Extract realized PnL from closed positions/contracts.
Reconciles intended vs actual execution, feeds realized PnL to settlement and learning

MT5_demo.note: Use closed positions, not floating open PnL

Deriv_demo.note: Use closed contract P/L, not proposal-time payout estimates

canonicalHamiltonians.name: Evidence - Hash-Chained Audit Log
canonicalHamiltonians.description: Every collapse or refusal leaves verifiable evidence. SHA-256 JSONL hash chain (runtime execution evidence) plus optional Merkle roots and Ed25519 signatures (evidence bundles). GitHub commits anchor code and curated reports. No execution unauditable.

implementations.description: SHA-256 hash-chained JSONL record. Each record stores previous_hash, canonical payload, record_hash. Maintains GENESIS_HASH and sequential integrity.
Iterator over JSONL audit log. Validates hash chain on read.
Canonical evidence event: event_type, execution_id, operation, payload, symbol, outcome, token_status
Unified H13 evidence facade. Appends to hash chain, includes optional anchor status (disabled by default)
Optional evidence bundles with Merkle roots and Ed25519 signatures for optional public anchoring
Appends execution result to evidence chain with all decision data

runtime_execution.proves: Each execution and refusal with canonical payload

public_anchor.proves: Code version and curated reports are publicly anchored

layerArchitecture.name: Data Preparation
layerArchitecture.description: Ingest and normalize external market data into canonical state vector
layerArchitecture.responsibility: Ensure all external inputs (MT5, Deriv, TradingView) are normalized to canonical form before geometry computation

layerArchitecture.name: Market Manifold Characterization
layerArchitecture.description: Compute Riemannian geometry: liquidity field, metric, connection, curvature. Classify market regime.
layerArchitecture.responsibility: Transform ICT structures into differential geometry that governs path integral weightings

layerArchitecture.name: Proposal Generation
layerArchitecture.description: Generate candidate market futures via path integral, compress into families, compute action scores
layerArchitecture.responsibility: Create N diverse trajectories, compress via Ramanujan signatures, score via weighted action functional

layerArchitecture.name: Orchestration & Validation
layerArchitecture.description: Apply constraints, reject forbidden proposals, measure entropy, enforce admissibility before collapse
layerArchitecture.responsibility: Guard proposal space: risk checks, constraint projectors, entropy gate. No forbidden paths reach scheduler.

layerArchitecture.name: Authority & Execution
layerArchitecture.description: Scheduler authorizes collapse and mints execution tokens. Execution boundaries validate tokens before side effects.
layerArchitecture.responsibility: Enforce token-gated execution: scheduler is sole authority, all execution boundaries validate, refusal evidence emitted on denial

layerArchitecture.name: Settlement & Learning
layerArchitecture.description: Reconcile broker reality with proposals, realize PnL, feed learning pipeline
layerArchitecture.responsibility: Bridge broker asynchronous settlement back to learning: use realized closed-position PnL, not floating estimates

layerArchitecture.name: Evidence & Auditability
layerArchitecture.description: Emit hash-chained evidence for every execution and refusal. Support public anchoring.
layerArchitecture.responsibility: All runtime decisions recorded in durable, auditable form. Prove every collapse and refusal.

dataFlow.description: Normalized market state (price, time, liquidity coordinates) flows to geometry layer
dataFlow.dataStructure: Dict with OHLCV, microstructure, symbol, timestamp

dataFlow.description: Liquidity field values and metric tensor passed to connection layer for Christoffel symbol computation
Metric derivatives (∂ϕ/∂p, ∂ϕ/∂t) used to compute Gaussian curvature K
Market regime (BASIN/FLAT/SADDLE/TRANSITION) informs trajectory seed selection and weights
Christoffel symbols bend trajectory seeds; seeds evolved via RK4 to generate paths
dataFlow.dataStructure: List of (time, price) tuples with connection corrections

dataFlow.description: All N trajectories compressed into K family representatives using Ramanujan signatures
Trajectories' energy components feed into action cost computation S[γ]
Regime classification adjusts w_L, w_T, w_E, w_R weights for action scoring
Action-scored proposals passed to risk manager and constraint projectors for admissibility filtering
Only proposals passing risk and constraint checks reach entropy gate
If information gain exceeds threshold, pass selected trajectory to scheduler for authorization
Scheduler mints execution token and passes to execution boundary
dataFlow.dataStructure: ExecutionToken with operation, budget, constraints, expiry

dataFlow.description: Shadow/live execution result (fills, prices, timing) passed to reconciliation
Settlement result (accepted, realized_pnl, evidence_valid) appended to evidence chain
Scheduler's token mint decision logged with conditions and authority state
Risk or admissibility failures emit refusal evidence without reaching scheduler

pipelineArchitecture.name: 20-Stage Canonical Pipeline
pipelineArchitecture.description: Active PipelineOrchestrator with 19 decision stage handlers plus completion/failure terminal states

stages.name: DATA_INGESTION
stages.description: Load raw market data from MT5, Deriv, or replay sources

stages.name: STATE_CONSTRUCTION
stages.description: Normalize to canonical market state (OHLCV, microstructure)

stages.name: ICT_EXTRACTION
stages.description: Extract ICT geometry (order blocks, FVGs, liquidity pools)

stages.name: GEOMETRY_COMPUTATION
stages.description: Compute liquidity field ϕ, metric tensor ds²

stages.name: FIELD_EVALUATION
stages.description: Maxwell tensor diagnostics, Minkowski causality, polarity detection

stages.name: TRAJECTORY_GENERATION
stages.description: Generate N candidate futures via RK4, geodesic-corrected

stages.name: RAMANUJAN_COMPRESSION
stages.description: Group trajectories into deterministic behavior families

stages.name: ACTION_EVALUATION
stages.description: Compute action S[γ] = w_L·S_L + w_T·S_T + w_E·S_E + w_R·S_R

stages.name: PATH_INTEGRAL
stages.description: Weight trajectories via exp(-S[γ]/ℏ), apply ε-calibration

stages.name: INTERFERENCE_SELECTION
stages.description: Select top-ranked path via path integral weights

stages.name: PATH_SELECTION
stages.description: Finalize selected trajectory for proposal generation

stages.name: ADMISSIBILITY_FILTERING
stages.description: Early risk and constraint filtering

stages.name: PROPOSAL_GENERATION
stages.description: Package selected trajectory into execution proposal

stages.name: ADMISSIBILITY_CHECK
stages.description: Final admissibility gate before entropy

stages.name: ENTROPY_GATE
stages.description: Measure ΔS and verify information gain > threshold

stages.name: SCHEDULER_COLLAPSE
stages.description: Scheduler authorizes collapse and mints execution token

stages.name: EXECUTION
stages.description: Token-validated broker execution (shadow/live/HFT)

stages.name: RECONCILIATION
stages.description: Reconcile intended vs realized, extract closed PnL

stages.name: EVIDENCE_EMISSION
stages.description: Append to hash-chained audit log

stages.name: WEIGHT_UPDATE
stages.description: Optional ML feedback: update path integral weights

entryPoints.name: PipelineOrchestrator.execute()
entryPoints.description: Main entry point: accepts market data dict, runs full 20-stage pipeline, returns PipelineContext with all decision checkpoints
entryPoints.input: Dict with symbol, timestamp, OHLCV data, source
entryPoints.output: PipelineContext with all stage results, evidence_hash, and final decision

entryPoints.name: ApexEngine.execute_canonical_cycle()
entryPoints.description: Lower-level entry point: explicit 7-step cycle with state machine validation. Used when finer control over orchestration is needed.

entryPoints.name: backend_api routes
entryPoints.description: API layer entry points for user commands and observation. Read state without bypassing authority.

entryPoints.name: Scheduler.authorize_collapse()
entryPoints.description: Scheduler authority entry point: gates token issuance with decision logic and constraints

dataStructures.name: PipelineContext
dataStructures.description: Master context object that flows through entire pipeline. Maintains typed state at each stage: market_state, ict_geometry, trajectories, proposals, execution_result, evidence_hash. Attached to every stage result.

dataStructures.name: Trajectory
dataStructures.description: Represents single candidate market future: sequence of (time, price) points, action, energy, operator scores. Core object of H5 path space.

dataStructures.name: ExecutionToken
dataStructures.description: Canonical authority facade over TAEP and trading tokens. Stores operation, budget, expiry_duration, constraints. Required for execution boundaries.

dataStructures.name: EvidenceEvent
dataStructures.description: Canonical event emitted to H13 hash chain. Records decision point (execution, refusal, token mint) with all relevant metadata.

dataStructures.name: ReconciliationReport
dataStructures.description: Canonical H12 output: summarizes broker settlement reconciliation for QPT and evidence layers.

orchestrators.name: PipelineOrchestrator
orchestrators.description: Main orchestrator: wires 20-stage pipeline, validates checkpoints, handles failures. Primary entry point for full execution.
responsibilities: Load and stage raw data through all 20 stages
Route failures and refusals to evidence chain

orchestrators.name: ApexEngine
orchestrators.description: Master engine orchestrator: explicit state machine, 7-step cycle, canonical execution model. Lower-level control point.
responsibilities: Emit refusal evidence on invalid token

orchestrators.name: Scheduler
orchestrators.description: Authority orchestrator: sole token issuer, collapse decision gatekeeper. Central point of authorization.
responsibilities: Mint execution tokens on authorized proposals
Integrate with constraint and risk layers

authorities.name: TokenAuthority
authorities.description: Token lifecycle manager: issuance, validation, revocation. Enforces token expiry and scope.

authorities.name: ProductionRiskManager
authorities.description: H8 authority: enforces daily loss limits, position sizing, kill switch. Guards admissibility.

validators.name: validate_token()
validators.description: Single canonical execution-boundary validation entrypoint. All execution boundaries call this before side effects.
validators.responsibility: Reject proposals without valid, non-expired tokens. Emit refusal evidence.

validators.name: validate_rootfile()
validators.description: CI validator: checks operator metadata against core/rootfile_manifest.py. Enforces canonical law ownership and allowed couplings.
validators.responsibility: Verify code conforms to declared law positions and invariants

internalDependencies.reason: Pipeline orchestrator imports all stage handlers
Orchestration layer adapts and coordinates lower-level components
Execution boundaries validate tokens and emit evidence
Authority facade wraps existing token implementations
Scheduler integrates with constraints and total Hamiltonian

externalDependencies.reason: Numerical computation for field, trajectory, and Hamiltonian calculations
OHLCV data structures and time series operations
ML models and reinforcement learning for adaptive weights

Deriv broker integration for contracts and settlement

canonicalLawOwnership.rule: Every operator must declare @declare_operator(META) with canonical_law
canonicalLawOwnership.violationPenalty: CI failure; operator not recognized as rootfile-tier

allowedCouplings.rule: Hamiltonians may only import from their declared allowed_couplings

tokenRequirement.rule: All execution boundaries must validate token before side effects
tokenRequirement.violationPenalty: Refusal evidence emitted; execution refused; error logged

evidenceEmission.rule: Every collapse and refusal must emit evidence to hash chain

noSelfAuthorization.rule: No operator may mint its own execution token
noSelfAuthorization.enforcement: Scheduler is sole issuer; token_validator gates execution
noSelfAuthorization.violationPenalty: Access denied; evidence logged; operator may be disabled

environmentVariables.name: ENABLE_FIELD_HAMILTONIAN

environmentVariables.name: ENABLE_ANCHORING
environmentVariables.description: When 1, attempts external evidence anchoring. Non-blocking: records anchor_status=failed but continues.

environmentVariables.name: APEX_ANCHOR_ENDPOINT
environmentVariables.description: External anchoring endpoint URL (only used if ENABLE_ANCHORING=1)

environmentVariables.name: APEX_EVIDENCE_LOG
environmentVariables.description: Path to hash-chained execution evidence log

runtimeModes.name: Shadow (default)

runtimeModes.name: Live

runtimeModes.name: HFT (scoped)
